title: Derive the shipping types
prompt:
Replace the five hand-written types with types **derived** from `SHIPPING_ZONES` and `CheckoutResponse`, so that adding a zone or changing the API type updates them automatically:

- `Zone`: the zone names.
- `ShippingCountry`: every country in every zone.
- `FeeCents`: every zone's fee, as literal numbers.
- `LineItem`: one element of `CheckoutResponse['lines']`.
- `CheckoutStatus`: the type of the order's `status`.

Then make `zoneFor` and `feeFor` compile with the new types (no `any`).
hints: Start from `typeof SHIPPING_ZONES`; `keyof` of that gives the zone names.
Index with the union of zone names to reach every config at once: `ShippingZones[Zone]['feeCents']`. Arrays are indexed with `number`.
`Object.entries` and `Object.keys` give you `string` keys. Since `SHIPPING_ZONES` is your own `as const` object, `Object.keys(SHIPPING_ZONES) as Zone[]` is an honest, local cast.
explanation: `typeof` brings the config object into the type world, `keyof` lists its zone names, and indexed access with the union `Zone` reaches into every zone at once, so `ShippingZones[Zone]['countries'][number]` collects all countries. `CheckoutResponse['lines'][number]` names the line-item type without copying its fields. `Object.keys` returns `string[]` because objects can carry extra keys at runtime; for a const object you defined, casting to `Zone[]` is safe, and the cast sits next to a comment saying why.

checks.types: The file type-checks with zero errors, including all type tests
checks.zone: `zoneFor` finds the right zone for a country
